item.title: Spokane, WA woman arrested for threatening to kill Minnesota FBI agent
item.description: Federal authorities in Spokane, Washington, arrested a woman who allegedly threatened to kill a Minnesota FBI agent after stealing his ID during a January riot.

item.title: Seattle weather: Rain returns late Tuesday night
item.description: Seattle and the surrounding area has not seen rain in two weeks, but that changes Tuesday night as a front arrives along with more mild temperatures.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks support Army veteran in VA hospice rooting for Super Bowl win
item.description: An Army veteran given just days to live in November continues to cheer for the Seahawks from his bed.

item.title: Washington Huskies release 2026 football season schedule
item.description: The Washington Huskies have released their 2026 football season schedule, opening with a four-game homestand before taking on some tough Big Ten competition.

item.title: 2 people, dog found dead in Pierce County, WA homicide investigation
item.description: Pierce County sheriff’s deputies are investigating a homicide after a man reported finding his wife, adult son and dog dead from gunshot wounds inside a Key Center home.

item.title: Tacoma, WA man sentenced to federal prison for fentanyl trafficking conspiracy
item.description: An 18-month wiretap investigation has landed a Tacoma man in federal prison for his involvement in a major drug trafficking conspiracy.

item.title: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Puget Sound calling for mentors
item.description: January is National Mentoring Month, but here in our backyard, hundreds of children are still waiting for a role model to step up.

item.title: Seattle Mariners acquired catcher Jhonny Pereda from Twins for cash considerations
item.description: The Seattle Mariners acquired catcher Jhonny Pereda from the Minnesota Twins for cash considerations on Tuesday.

item.title: Seattle I-5 trooper carjacking suspect deemed incompetent for trial
item.description: A man accused of carjacking a Washington State Patrol lieutenant on I-5 and leading police on a chase has been found incompetent to stand trial.

item.title: Drake Maye says shoulder isn't 100 percent, but he'll play in Super Bowl against Seahawks
item.description: Drake Maye says his throwing shoulder is fine. Maybe not 100 percent, but the Patriots quarterback said Tuesday he’ll be available for the Super Bowl against the Seattle Seahawks.
